whatItDoes: Converts an amount from one currency to another using live exchange rates for 160+ world currencies. Rates are fetched from a public exchange-rate API and cached for 10 minutes.
whyItExists: Exchange rates move constantly and using a stale or wrong rate can misprice an invoice, budget, or travel plan. This tool gives a current, clearly dated rate in one click.
whoShouldUse: Freelancers and contractors invoicing across currencies, travelers budgeting abroad, online shoppers price-comparing, and anyone handling foreign currency transactions.
useCases: Convert an invoice amount into your home currency
Check what a foreign price equals before paying
Estimate travel spending before a trip
Compare international prices when shopping online
instructions: Enter the amount you want to convert
Read the converted amount and the exchange rate used
Press Refresh rates to load a fresh rate after 10 minutes
bestPractices: Use a recent rate for accurate quotes, since rates change constantly
Keep in mind banks and card networks add a margin over the mid-market rate
Refresh the rates once more right before a real transaction
Confirm the target currency code for the country you need
commonMistakes: Using a stale rate from memory or an old page
Confusing the From and To direction
Assuming the rate shown is the final rate after bank fees
Mixing currency codes (USD vs US dollar abbreviations)
faq: Where do the rates come from? — A public exchange-rate API refreshed every 10 minutes.
Why are rates cached for 10 minutes? — To keep the tool fast and avoid hammering the free API; a 10-minute window is fine for planning.
Are these the rates my bank gives? — No. Banks and cards add fees or margins on top of the mid-market rate.
Is my data shared? — No. Only the shared rate table is fetched; no personal data leaves your browser.
